text: Roles exactly one : design Byte-identical pass-. Trial / site / replicate / block / plot / row / column / year etc. treatment factor cardinality per-level frequency; optional label aliasing seeded permutation. outcome Re-simulated via Gaussian copula. Multiple allowed. covariate Numeric: Gaussian copula (joint outcomes). Categorical: row-permuted, levels preserved (local) aliased (collaborate). ignore Dropped passed depending mask() options; auto-assigned date/time, free text, PII-pattern names. Default classification rules, applied order: PII-pattern column names (contact, email, phone, gps, latitude/longitude, postcode, ssn, password, owner, farmer, operator, etc., case-insensitive substring) -> ignore pii_suspected = TRUE. Date / POSIXct / POSIXlt / difftime columns -> ignore. ID-pattern names (\\bid\\b, _id$, ^id_) -> ignore. Design-pattern names (rep, block, row, col(umn)?, range, plot()?, site, env(ironment)?, trial, year, season, colrep, tos) -> design. Treatment-pattern names (treatment, variety, cultivar, genotype, ^trt, ^dose) -> treatment. Character columns > 50% unique values non-NA -> ignore (likely free text). Everything else -> covariate. user re-classifies one columns outcome. Failing designate least one outcome hard error mask() time (via roles_validate()).
